subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live owner-session delivery proof, or may maintainers explicitly accept source and CI proof only for the Telegram-visible path?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but the changed behavior is a user-visible session/message-delivery path that tests and CI cannot fully prove without a real transport or gateway run.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the risk that real transport delivery still misroutes or drops the final message.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths first.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest cross-cutting history across heartbeat routing and subagent announce delivery.
